name: kettlebell sit up press
description: Sit up from the floor with a kettlebell and press it overhead at the top. A core and shoulder combo move.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent, holding a kettlebell at your chest.
Curl and sit up using your abs.
Press the kettlebell overhead as you reach the top.
Lower it back to your chest.
Roll back down slowly and repeat.
